scope: Independent actual-original source/art and repeated-image review of existing stage3/4/30 panorama drafts; no native/final acceptance or runtime selection.

candidates.prompt:
Create a beautiful bespoke SOURCE-FAITHFUL painterly repair of this Legend of Dragoon battle panorama, matching a polished AA2026 game that presents its original retro art. Edit the supplied SQUARE authoring canvas, keep it EXACTLY square, preferably1536x1536. Reference1 is the authoritative original. Reference2 is the existing neural development baseline, only a boundary aid; original topology controls. The panorama occupies ONLY the preregistered rectangle [64, 0, 256, 384] in a384x384 coordinate grid. Keep every exterior padding pixel black. Preserve that rectangle placement and all internal feature positions and proportions. Do not zoom, reframe, rotate or extend the panorama.
Scene intent: Dark ochre cavern, hanging rock points, multiple ledges, ladders and small barred openings. Source positions and scene identity compared directly with original.
Refine enlarged pixels and neural blur into continuous polished painted surfaces, fine source-supported material detail and graceful gradients. Keep the ORIGINAL palette, illumination, darkness, haze and soft distant depth; do not increase saturation/contrast to make a dramatic new scene. Preserve every original window/arch/motif/rib, large cloud group, shoreline, ridge, branch, reflection and ambiguous shape. No invented lights, extra clouds/objects, larger mountains, new cracks, readable symbols, transformed architecture, sparkles or lighting beams. Existing soft uniform sky/fog/glow remains soft. No added directional lighting that conflicts with the game lighting. Preserve both original edge compositions exactly for later repeated-panorama seam review; do not average or mirror edges. Fine organic surfaces stay matte, no wool fibers or glossy strands. Output opaque square RGB/RGBA image, no text, frame or border. This is a source-bound texture repair, not a newly composed landscape.

review.intent: Dark ochre cavern, hanging rock points, multiple ledges, ladders and small barred openings. Source positions and scene identity compared directly with original.
review.style: Fine source-supported painterly surfaces and graceful gradients retain the original palette and authored light; avoid invented scene objects.
review.layout: Retains organic building apertures, platform/ladder placements, diagonal walkway and lower shadow platforms.
review.wrap: Original edge compositions preserved without averaging or mirroring. Repeated-panorama and native camera acceptance remain pending.
